title: Daallo Airlines 159

agencies.name: Ministry of Transport and Civil Aviation of Federal Republic of Somalia
agencies.report_title: Final Report - Accident to the AIRBUS A321 registered SX-BHS

agencies.name: Bureau d'Enquêtes et d'Analyses pour la sécurité de l'aviation civile

summary: Daallo Airlines Flight 159, an Airbus A321, departed Mogadishu with 74 passengers and 7 crew en route to Djibouti. At 14,000 feet altitude, 20 minutes after takeoff, an explosion occurred in the cabin creating a fuselage hole near seats 15/16F at the forward wing root. Investigators confirmed explosive residue and concluded the bomb was likely concealed in a laptop and carried aboard by a person in a wheelchair. Only the suicide bomber died; the aircraft successfully returned to Mogadishu for emergency landing.
probable_cause: The explosion was caused by a bomb detonated in a suicide attack, hidden within a laptop. The Islamist militant group Al-Shabaab claimed responsibility. The flight was delayed 20 minutes awaiting additional passengers, which prevented the aircraft from reaching cruising altitude where the explosion could have been catastrophic.

factors.evidence: an explosion occurred on board the aircraft at 10,400 feet, 20 minutes after takeoff. The investigation indicated that the explosion was caused by a bomb detonated in a suicide attack. The Islamist militant group Al-Shabaab claimed responsibility (p. 4)
The explosion created a hole in the fuselage behind the R2 door at approximately 1 square meter at the level of row 16 around frame 35.8 (p. 8)
The aircraft returned to Aden Adde International Airport and performed an emergency landing safely at 08:53 UTC, 12 minutes after the explosion. There were three injuries on board (p. 5)
A bomb hidden within a laptop was carried onto the aircraft by a passenger in a wheelchair, suggesting airport security screening procedures failed to detect it (p. 4)

events.text: Flight delayed 20 minutes awaiting additional passengers to board
Flight DAO159 cleared for takeoff from runway 05, wind 090 degrees at 17 knots
ATC cleared flight to climb to FL 300; aircraft passing 9,000 feet
Explosion in cabin at 10,400 feet altitude; sound heard on CVR
Master Warning and CAB PR EXCESS CAB ALT message triggered on ECAM
Captain takes control of aircraft; applies nose down inputs and left turn orders
First Officer requests ATC clearance for emergency return to Mogadishu
Flight attendant reports explosion in cabin; Captain confirms safe return
Cabin pressure warning turns off at 8,100 feet altitude
Aircraft lands safely at Mogadishu airport in full configuration

recommendations.text: Search all passenger baggage and employees at Mogadishu airport
Have all laptops switched on before checking in
Perform random questioning of passengers based on profiles
Implement Somalian Police Force (SPF) watchers in uniform at each access point
Install random swabs with disposable explosive detection kits
Reinforce the separation between the passengers terminals and cargo areas
